subject: planner: add newly created col for window projection (#52378)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff; the only planner behavior change is in `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` (`buildByItemsForWindow`). When rewriting window PARTITION BY / ORDER BY items, if the rewrite returns a `*expression.Column` that was newly added to the plan schema (e.g., produced by scalar/correlated subquery rewrite via Apply), the code now ensures that column is also appended to the window projection’s `Exprs/names/schema` if missing. This is a localized planner fix to prevent missing-column resolution failures during later `ResolveIndices`/physical property handling for window partition/order keys. No correctness/semantics/compatibility/concurrency/privilege Blocker/High issues found in this change.
